questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Unimelb har mange gode og spændende fag for geografer med en masse feltarbejde. Udover det så starter semestret tidlige og slutter allerede i november, så man har tid til at backpacker bagefter inden man skal starte igen i februar her hjemme.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Inden jeg kom derned syntes jeg det var svært at finde ud af. Da man var ankommet og kunne snakke med studieinformation på campus var det nemt nok at finde alle de informationer man skal bruge - der er meget hjælp at hente hos Stop One, som er studieinformation på campus, hvis man ønsker det - måske bare bestil tid i forvejen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Der var flere oplæg fra studieinformation om ens udveksling og universitetet som var obligatoriske at deltage i den første uge. Det hjalp meget.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer:
Det var lidt svært og man skal måske være ude i god tid, eller være tålmodig. On campus housing er meget dyrt, men det er nemt at skaffe. off campus kan være væsentlig billiger og hyggeligere. 

Jeg boede i  CSA student accommodation og det var rigtigt fint og væsentlig billiger end on-campus, ellers så tjek Fairy Floss Real Estate på facebook ud for at finde accommodation.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Det er meget hyggeliger og billiger at bo off campus - lejlighederne omkring campus og på er dyre, grimme og små, men med mange fester og andre medstudernde.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det er ligetil at udføre når man først kommer igang - man skal dog være opmærksom på hårde deadlines der ligger meget tidligt i semesteret. Plus at nogle kurser kræver skrevne tilladelser fra kursusansvarlige. Det er derfor en god ide at være tidligt ude med hvilke kurser man gerne vil have.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Stop One var studenterservice og var gode at snakke med - de hjælper med alt.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg kom med på alle de kurser jeg ville have - men har også været heldig da professorerne var hurtige til at give mig tilladelser til at registre mig til kurser inden deadlinen.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær hurtigt ude med hvilke kurser du vil på, og kig grundigt i kursus kataloget. Mange kurser ligger ikke under de samme institutter som du måske regner med ud fra KU.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: BA niveauet er under KU på første og andet år, mens tredje er meget det samme niveau som KU. Det er fordi at unimelb studerede ikke vælger et hovedfag før tredje år og fagene på de to første år skal derfor "sælges" til de studerende.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det er meget gymnasie agtig, dog meget individuelt uden meget gruppe arbejde.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Environmental Change & the Human Journey
Past Climates: Icehouse to Greenhouse
Understanding Planet Earth
Global Climate Change in Context

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Global Climate Change in Context og Biogeography and Ecology of Fire. Fede feltture til enten New Zealand eller Tasmanien.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Husleje er dyrt, men er meget værre på on-campus student accommodation.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Øl er meget er dyrt - en billig fadøl koster nemt 60kr men kan nemt koster 100kr.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Der er mange klubber på universitet som man kan melde sig ind i. Sport klubber, kultur klubber mm.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Jeg vil anbefale Melbourne mountaineering club, som er en vandre og frilufts klub. Derudover var jeg med i dykkerklubben som er en meget aktiv social klub.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Lej en bil ( eller få en sød aussi ven med en bil) og kør ud af Melbourne til nogle af de mange smukke nationalparker som ligger ikke særlig langt væk fra byen. ( Budj bim , grampians, Ottaway national park, Wilsons prom)

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt, aussi´erne er meget søde og nemme at være sammen med.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Meld dig ind i nogle klubber og snak med dine medstuderende i timerne - ikke hold dig tilbage!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: studerende på unimelb har måske lidt en gymnasie vibe en gang imellem. Men det er ikke noget rigtigt problem og ikke så kulturelt.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Aussier er meget nede på jorden og nemme at snakke med og blive venner med hvis man har lyst.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer:
- Kig godt i kursus kataloget, også under andre institutter og departementer.    
- led efter accommodation på fairy floss real estate
- Melbourne er dyre end man tror, men man skal nok klare det.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er fedt at bo i Brunwick, Carlton, Fritroy, Collingwood.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: De venner man har fået er det bedste.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Nok alt det papir arbejde man skal få ordnet for at få lov til at komme afsted.

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
